title: Avalanche Run
reference: repeat 6 { while not wall_ahead { forward if on_switch { activate } } if tile_is r { turn_left } else { turn_right } }
hints: The last run before the peak. Corridors, switches and signal pads, all on thin ice.
Walk each corridor until a wall, flipping switches as you pass. At the corner, red turns left and blue turns right. Repeat.
repeat 6 { while not wall_ahead { forward if on_switch { activate } } if tile_is r { turn_left } else { turn_right } }
